title: GFCC Contribution Port v1 (CoCo)
description: CoCo loop: attest → fulfill → appeal. Recognition is the narrative; points/tokens are not. v1 does not require a chain. Fulfillment may mint identity.capability_trace after appeal window.
not: a points leaderboard as the product
on-chain settlement as a v1 must-have

on_chain.narrative: v1 的格契不依赖链；链是未来可选的一层，不是现在的承诺。

attest.notes: Cannot attest solely for oneself as the only evidence.

fulfill.notes: Marks attested claim as fulfilled; may append identity.capability_trace with source_port=contribution and weight=evidence after appeal is not open.

invariants: Points/tokens if present are derived views, never the source of truth
Appeal exists before any reputation write-back is final
Fulfillment may feed identity.append_trace; identity must not mint its own trace
